title: 板壁低位回步
description: 孔版印刷画面中，成人缓缓退回较低脚点，墙角与软垫清晰。

art_direction.medium: crisp digital comic ink and quiet halftone shadows
art_direction.scene: An original risograph illustration depicts a fictional adult making a deliberate downward step on a low slab problem. One shoe lowers to a broad visible foothold near the continuous crash mat while the other foot and both hands preserve easy support. The gently angled wall carries large violet holds with a compact route layout, and the torso remains upright instead of falling away. Use a medium-wide three-quarter composition with the full adult and clear padded floor. Layer dusty blue, pale lilac, and warm ochre ink textures with slight print irregularities. All garments are opaque. Exclude words, logos, falling, jumps, dangerous height, and blocked landing space.
